Ordinary Shield

You slip your arm into place and feel the worn grip fit your palm.

Rules

- ID: item-ordinary-shield - Bulk: 1 - Requirements / supply: No DP; ordinary equipment - Acquisition: Explicit ability grant, coins, or DA treasure; no automatic extra starting kit.

A held shield enables universal Shield Block. Grants no automatic resistance or defense bonus without spending its Reaction.

No DP price. Purchase does not grant training or an ability.

Equipment index

Market price: 10 coins. Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
